name: Goose Creek Floor Studio
tagline: A flooring showroom and install crew in Baytown since 2009.

hero.title: Floors you choose in person, installed by our own crew.
hero.lead: Walk the showroom, take samples home, and get one written price for the floor, the prep and the install.
hero.imageAlt: A bright living room with pale oak floors, a white sofa and tall linen curtains

categories.title: Hardwood
categories.short: Solid and engineered oak, hickory and maple.
categories.text: Real wood in site-finished and prefinished planks, from narrow red oak to wide white oak. Engineered boards go over slab, which is most of the houses around Baytown.
categories.textureAlt: Close view of light white oak planks
categories.imageAlt: A dining room with warm oak floors and a long white table

features.title: Engineered for slab
features.text: A real wood wear layer over a stable core, glued or floated over concrete.

features.title: Refinish later
features.text: Thicker wear layers can be sanded and refinished when the finish wears.

features.title: Stairs and trim
features.text: Matching stair treads, nosing and transitions ordered with the floor.

categories.title: Luxury Vinyl
categories.short: Waterproof plank and tile for kitchens and baths.
categories.text: Rigid-core plank and tile that looks like wood or stone and shrugs off water, dogs and kids. The floor most of our customers pick for the whole downstairs.
categories.textureAlt: Close view of grey-brown vinyl planks with a wood grain
categories.imageAlt: A white kitchen with a marble island over pale vinyl plank floors

features.title: Waterproof core
features.text: Spills and mopping stay on top instead of swelling the boards.

features.title: One floor, every room
features.text: Runs through kitchens, baths and living areas without a transition.

features.title: Quiet underfoot
features.text: An attached pad softens footsteps on slab.

categories.title: Tile
categories.text: Large-format porcelain, wood-look plank tile, marble mosaics and shower floors, set by installers who level the slab before the first tile goes down.
categories.textureAlt: Close view of white marble hexagon mosaic tile
categories.imageAlt: A walk-in shower with marble-look porcelain walls and a dark tile floor

features.title: Floors and showers
features.text: Floors, shower pans, walls and backsplashes in one visit.

features.title: Flat to start with
features.text: Slabs are ground and leveled so large tiles sit flat.

features.title: Waterproofed
features.text: Membranes under every shower and wet-area floor.

categories.title: Carpet
categories.short: Soft carpet for bedrooms, stairs and game rooms.
categories.text: Nylon, polyester and wool carpet in plush, textured and patterned styles, with pad matched to the room and seams placed where nobody walks.
categories.textureAlt: Close view of soft beige cut-pile carpet
categories.imageAlt: A bedroom with new soft brown carpet and a sliding door to a deck

features.title: Pet-friendly fibers
features.text: Stain-resistant fibers that clean up after accidents.

features.title: Stairs done right
features.text: Wrapped or waterfall stairs, stretched tight and stapled clean.

features.title: Old carpet hauled off
features.text: Removal and disposal included in the price.

categories.title: Laminate
categories.short: The look of wood at a lower price.
categories.text: Water-resistant laminate with a realistic wood surface and a hard top layer that stands up to chairs, toys and claws. A good fit for rentals and busy family rooms.
categories.textureAlt: Close view of honey-toned laminate planks
categories.imageAlt: A living room with light laminate floors, a fireplace and a glass coffee table

features.title: Scratch resistant
features.text: A tough wear layer that holds up to pets and furniture.

features.title: Fast install
features.text: Most rooms are done in a day, with no glue and no smell.

features.title: Spill protection
features.text: Sealed edges keep everyday spills from soaking in.

process.title: Visit
process.text: Walk the showroom, see full boards in daylight, and take samples home to try against your walls and light.

process.title: Measure
process.text: We measure every room at your house, check the subfloor, and give you one written price before anything is ordered.

process.title: Install
process.text: Our own crew moves the furniture, preps the floor and installs it, then cleans up and hauls the old flooring away.

about.title: A family floor store on Garth Road.
text: We opened on Garth Road in 2009 with a few racks of carpet and a single install crew. Today the showroom holds hundreds of full-size samples, and the same people who sell you the floor are the ones who put it in.
Bring a cabinet door, a paint chip or a photo of your room. We will pull boards off the wall, lay them on the floor by the window, and send you home with the ones you like.
about.imageAlt: A flooring showroom with tall wood plank sample panels on the walls

estimate.title: Get a free estimate.
estimate.text: Tell us about the rooms and the floor you have in mind. We will call to set a time to measure, and you get a written price for the floor, the prep and the install.

reviews.author: Homeowner in Baytown
reviews.text: We brought a cabinet door in and they laid six different planks next to it by the window. Ended up with a white oak we never would have picked from a picture. The crew finished the whole downstairs in three days.

reviews.author: Homeowner in Mont Belvieu
reviews.text: The price they wrote down after measuring is what we paid. They even leveled a low spot in the slab we did not know we had.

reviews.author: Homeowner in La Porte
reviews.text: New carpet upstairs and vinyl in the kitchen. Moved all the furniture, hauled the old carpet off, and vacuumed before they left.

reviews.author: Homeowner in Crosby
reviews.text: Took home three tile samples twice before deciding. Nobody rushed us, and the shower floor came out perfect.
